parameters.name: assetUrl
parameters.description: Only comments pinned to this photo/video of the post. Works with or without paging.

parameters.name: take
parameters.description: Top-level comments per page (default 30 once paging is on). Switches the response to a `CommentsPage`.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description:
Opaque `nextCursor` from the previous page. Switches the response
to a `CommentsPage`. An unparseable cursor restarts from the newest
page; deleting the comment it points at doesn't break it.
